shared_elements: rectangular recessed panel / niche-like framed field cut into a vertical wall
justification: B shows a legible figural scene — a rayed disc above standing figures flanking an offering table, over dense columns of sign-like text — whereas A shows only a bare cliff face with rectangular cut recesses and no discernible figures, signs or motifs at all. The only correspondence is the generic idea of a rectangular framed field on a vertical rock wall, which carries almost no iconographic weight.
